title: XCF Global, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing entry into a definitive Business Combination Agreement with DevvStream Corp. and Southern Energy Renewables Inc. The transaction involves mergers and a domestication of DevvStream from Alberta to Delaware, with equity holders receiving Company Common Shares upon closing.
key_points: XCF Global, Inc. (trading as SAFX on Nasdaq) entered a Business Combination Agreement on April 13, 2026
The transaction involves DevvStream Corp. (Alberta corporation) and Southern Energy Renewables Inc. (Louis Louisiana corporation)
DevvStream will domesticate as a Delaware corporation prior to merging
Southern will merge into a wholly-owned subsidiary of XCF; DevvStream will merge into a separate wholly-owned subsidiary
Outstanding DevvStream Warrants, Options, RSUs, and Convertible Notes will be assumed and converted into XCF Common Shares
Closing is conditioned on stockholder approvals, regulatory approvals, receipt of fairness opinions, and absence of prohibitive law or order
Company will file a registration statement on Form S-4 containing proxy statement and DevvStream circular
